fichas.title: Restaurants: planning and spatial design
fichas.summary: Restaurant planning should be coordinated with the operator and specialists, based on the menu, service system, target clientele, and site. Dining rooms should be furnished flexibly, larger rooms zoned, and supporting spaces grouped around the dining room. The page gives guidance on ceiling heights, exits, aisles, toilet access, and window area.
uses: Fast service at a food bar

fichas.title: Restaurant capacity, area, and aisle requirements
fichas.summary: Tables give usable walking widths by dining-room floor area, toilet-fixture counts by dining-place capacity, area allowances by restaurant type, furnishing space per place, and minimum aisle widths. The printed guidance also notes that storage and personnel rooms require additional area and that cover relates to seat turnover.
